description: LAUNCHING SOON: answers 503 until hiring signals go live (GET /pricing hiring_tech.available). The technologies a company's website and DNS show it uses, by its domain: analytics, marketing automation, CRM, chat, payments, CMS, framework, hosting and CDN, email and productivity suite, security, ATS and more. Each one has its category, the evidence (the script, header, cookie name, meta generator or DNS record that matched, and the page or record it was seen on), `source`, `fetched_at`, first_seen_at and last_seen_at. `status` is ok or none_detected (no rule matched; not proof the company uses nothing). Read live when the stored read is older than `max_age_hours`. Costs $0.006 per lookup whose status is ok; none_detected and errors are free. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

max_age_hours.description: Serve a stored read younger than this, else read live (1 to 720, default 72).
